title: Elon Musk is challenging Minnesota’s ban on ‘nudify’ services.
summary: The Musk-led company responsible for the Grok chatbot said the law will impact free speech and visual expression “in a clumsy attempt to prohibit ‘nudification.’” “See you in court, creep,” responded Minnesota Governor Tim Walz .
